latestVersion.changelog:
AI Automation Agency Builder v1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Scrapes LinkedIn, Google Maps, and job boards to identify businesses with manual workflow bottlenecks.
- Scores each lead based on automation ROI potential and pinpoints wasted time in business workflows.
- Generates personalized automation audit reports for each prospect.
- Builds a ready-to-use agency service menu with pricing suggestions.
- Produces customized client pitch videos via InVideo AI.
- Integrates Apify, InVideo AI, and Claude AI for a complete agency launch toolkit.
